senses.en_definition: A round or oval object, solid or hollow, used in games or sports.
Football; a game in which two teams of eleven players try to score by kicking a ball into the opposing team's goal.

messages.en: Let's play football at the field this evening. Can you make it?
Yeah, but my ball's flat. Can you bring yours?
Sure, no problem. See you at five.
Can you help me print this file?
Sure, email it to me now.

senses.en_definition: May …? Can …? Used to ask permission or make a polite request.
Can …? Used to ask whether someone is able to do something or whether something is possible.

collocations.en: can it be finished on time?

messages.en: Could I borrow your reference book for a moment? I just want to check something.
Sure, just grab it from my desk. Put it back there when you're done, okay?
Thanks! I'll return it before you head home.

senses.en_definition: An explosive weapon or device designed to cause damage or destruction.

messages.en: That bomb going off in the movie was so loud I dropped my popcorn!
No wonder I saw popcorn all over the floor under your seat 😂 It made me jump too.
